key_points: Q3 revenue beat ($399M vs est.) and full-year EPS guidance raised to high end ($4.63-$4.67)
Revenue declined 4.1% YoY, highlighting ongoing top-line pressure despite earnings improvement
Management cites hybrid deployment flexibility and AI progress as drivers of stronger outlook
Analyst fair value targets modestly revised up ($33.50 to $35.38) but split on AI upside sustainability
Brokerage consensus remains 'Hold'; stock still down 34% over 5 years
